name: Roberts
role: Partner in Pennell & Roberts; Medora saloon keeper
bio: Under the bare name Roberts, the paper reports a partner in Pennell & Roberts, which in 1884 backed the Deadwood freight route, lent its room over the 'Senate' for a stockmen's meeting, and in February 1885 brought back mules used on Canadian Pacific contract work. A Roberts also proposed with Paddock to surface Medora's streets with scoria, rode with an April 1884 posse after horse thieves, and in December 1884 shot George Heywood in his saloon after Heywood came in armed to kill him.
